seoTitle: Flow Rate Converter: L/min, GPM, m3/h, CFM
metaDescription: Convert litres per minute, US and UK gallons per minute or hour, cubic metres per hour and CFM. Free, offline.
intro: Converts flow rates between litres per minute or second, cubic metres per hour or second, US and UK gallons per minute or hour and cubic feet per minute.
why:
Pump, shower and ventilation specs use different flow units: L/min, GPM, m3/h or CFM. Comparing them needs the right gallon.

This tool shows all units at once, with US and UK gallons separate.

faq.a: 1 US gallon per minute is 3.785 L/min.
Cubic feet per minute, used for fans and air flow.
